heroTitle: Software that turns raw data into clear answers
heroText: VEGAVIT EOOD is a Bulgarian software company based in Plovdiv. We design and run our own web services: AI-driven news processing, monitoring tools and cost-saving utilities for working with large language models.
p1: An hourly digest of world artificial-intelligence news, published in ten languages. Sources are collected automatically, filtered for significance and summarised into short cards.
p2: A token economiser for large language models: it reduces the volume of text sent to an AI model, so the same work costs less.
p3: A cloud service for climate and cold-chain monitoring — for food producers, pharmaceuticals and medicine, biobanks and transport. Own low-cost sensors, tamper-evident records, alarms and calibration tracking. In development under the working name CoolBoxMonitor.
p4: An AI-driven generator of management decisions built on morphological vectors.
p5: A group of native applications with a shared server. You keep a private log of your catches and finds — fishing, hunting, mushrooms, berries — and may share a spot with one person of your choosing. There is no public feed and no common map: locations are never disclosed to everyone.
plat: In development for iOS, Android, macOS and Windows.
p6: lambit2FA — two-factor sign-in codes. The codes are kept in your phone, are synchronised between your own devices and reach nobody, us included, in readable form. Up to 300 codes. Free, no advertising.
mfgText: Besides software, we build equipment to order: AEF acoustic shock-freezing chambers for fish and seafood, meat, berries, fruit, confectionery and ready meals. Each chamber is made to the customer's specification.
win_note: There is no signature: on first run Windows shows "Unknown publisher" → "More info" → "Run anyway".
